templates.name: Data Processing Agreement
templates.description: A standardized data processing agreement developed collaboratively by over 40 legal professionals from technology vendors, procurement teams, and law firms. Covers data processor relationships, processing instructions, international data transfers, security incident response, audit rights, and data deletion.

templates.name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
templates.description: A mutual confidentiality agreement allowing both parties to share sensitive business and technical information. Includes standard terms for confidential information protection, permitted disclosures, term duration, and return/destruction of information.

templates.name: Professional Services Agreement
templates.description: Standard terms for professional services agreements with customizable statements of work. Covers service delivery, intellectual property assignments, payment terms, warranties, liability limitations, and indemnification.

templates.name: Cloud Service Agreement
templates.description: Comprehensive framework for cloud service agreements including access controls, support provisions, payment terms, data protection, and service warranties. Designed for SaaS and cloud platform providers.

templates.name: Business Associate Agreement
templates.description: HIPAA-compliant business associate agreement for healthcare data handling. Defines obligations for protecting protected health information (PHI), security requirements, breach notification, and compliance procedures.

templates.name: Service Level Agreement
templates.description: Standard service level agreement for cloud services defining uptime commitments, response times, service credits, and remedies for performance failures. Companion to Cloud Service Agreement.

templates.name: Software License Agreement
templates.description: Standardized software licensing agreement covering license grants, usage restrictions, payment terms, warranty disclaimers, and liability limitations. Includes provisions for updates, machine learning, and open source software.

templates.name: Partnership Agreement
templates.description: Framework for partnership agreements between organizations. Covers cooperation obligations, payment terms, trademark licensing, dispute resolution, and termination provisions.

templates.name: AI Addendum
templates.description: Supplementary terms for AI/ML services integrated into products. Covers AI service usage restrictions, training data handling, output ownership, intellectual property rights, and AI-specific disclaimers.

templates.name: Pilot Agreement
templates.description: Short-term evaluation agreement for product testing before full commercial commitment. Includes access rights, usage restrictions, feedback provisions, confidentiality, and transition to definitive agreements.

templates.name: Design Partner Agreement
templates.description: Framework for design partner programs providing early product access in exchange for feedback. Covers product access, feedback ownership, confidentiality, and intellectual property rights.

templates.name: Master Service Agreement
templates.note: Part of Common Paper's collection, referenced in organization
templates.description: Note: Referenced in Common Paper's repository list as part of their standard templates collection. Please check their organization page for the specific MSA repository.

cover_pages.name: Mutual NDA Cover Page
cover_pages.description: Cover page template for Mutual NDA including signature blocks, effective date, confidentiality term, governing law, and jurisdiction fields.

usage_patterns.implementation_model: Two-part execution with Cover Page + Standard Terms by reference
usage_patterns.cover_page_purpose: Customizable business terms that incorporate standard legal provisions by reference
usage_patterns.versioning_strategy: Version 1 remains permanently unchanged; future versions created for legal/use-case updates only
usage_patterns.licensing: All agreements under CC BY 4.0 - free to use and modify
usage_patterns.governance: Created by committees of 40+ attorneys from vendors, procurement teams, boutique firms, and Big Law
